headline: Former Central Bank of Chile president expects Dominican Republic's economy to grow
summary: Former Central Bank of Chile president Vittorio Corbo projects Dominican Republic growth of 4.6% in 2026. He flagged risks from high energy prices, international interest rates and possible AI-related financial corrections.
why: Growth forecasts shape investor expectations for a country's economy, bond spreads and currency. The Dominican Republic is a major Caribbean economy and tourism and services hub.
original_headline: Expresidente Banco Central de Chile prevé que economía de RD crezca
